data.title: Motor vehicle tax assessment for vehicle MS-JB 2604
data.summary: The Hauptzollamt Beispielhafen has fixed the annual motor vehicle tax (Kraftfahrzeugsteuer) for the vehicle with plate MS-JB 2604 at €146.00 per year, starting from the registration date of 2 November 2026, to be collected automatically by direct debit.
data.explanation: This is an official tax assessment for your vehicle's annual road tax. The amount of €146.00 per year will be debited automatically from your bank account on file — no transfer is needed from you. If you believe the amount or basis of the assessment is wrong, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the Hauptzollamt; the app shows the deadline for this. If you do nothing, the assessment becomes final and the tax will keep being collected each year as stated.

items.title: Decide whether to file an objection (Einspruch) against the tax assessment
items.action: If you disagree with the assessment, file an objection (Einspruch) with the Hauptzollamt Beispielhafen by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If you miss the deadline, the tax assessment becomes final and binding.

items.title: Annual vehicle tax (Kraftfahrzeugsteuer) collected by direct debit
items.action: No action needed — the tax is collected automatically by direct debit from the account on file; just make sure the account has sufficient funds.
